`.rs`/`.cu`/`.cuh`/`.wgsl` files under `crates/`. A rule that REFUSES a prohibited teacher has
to name what it refuses, so putting those names in source made the D23 interlock report the
RULE FILE as a violation - it cannot tell a file that IMPLEMENTS a mechanism from one that
The fix is not to weaken the interlock or to obfuscate the literal. The patterns are data: they
are what the rules match against, they belong beside the rules as a reviewed file, and the
harness already renders its rule text from registries rather than from constants.
How to describe a new prohibited teacher: add a phrase here, in lower case, as it would appear
in a pre-registration sheet. A sheet that STATES the prohibition is not proposing it - the rule
skips a match whose surrounding text acknowledges D23/D25.
